provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Dimensionless standard-state activities; Q=a_Red/(a_Ox*a_Hplus^2). E=E_standard-(R*T/(n*F))*ln(Q), n=2. Define pH=-log10(a_Hplus). Proton activity is an independent supplied observation, not inferred from a molecular graph.
target: Report E, dE/dpH at fixed Red/Ox ratio, and E_wrong_minus_E_correct when the quotient mistakenly contains a_Hplus^1 while electron count remains2. No reference-electrode conversion or liquid junction correction is implied.
